item.title: Nintendo Wins Court Case Ruling The Sale Of Switch "Circumvention Devices" Unlawful

description.p: "avoid purchasing or using circumvention devices".Nintendo is celebrating a court case victory in the Netherlands that says the sale of "devices designed to circumvent Nintendo’s security measures" is unlawful.Specifically referencing cards such as the MIG Switch Card, the case heard at The Hague District Court (Rechtbank Den Haag) involved a complaint against an online seller 'dropshipping' the devices from Asia. These devices can be used to play pirated copies of games and unofficial software on modified Switch hardware.Read the full article on nintendolife.com

item.title: Nintendo Switch 2 Welcome Tour Updated To Ver. 1.1.0, Here Are The Full Patch Notes

description.p: Got to account for that system update.As if all of this week's Direct shenanigans weren't enough, Nintendo yesterday released a surprise Switch 2 system update, adding VRR modes when playing on the TV. But what would such a feature be if it didn't appear in Nintendo Switch 2 Welcome Tour, eh? Worry not, the game has been updated too.The Welcome Tour Ver. 1.1.0 update was released this morning, tweaking the game's VRR Slider demo so that it can now also be played while the console is docked. You'll need to make sure that you've updated your Switch 2 Dock to do so, and you'll need a VRR-compatible screen, of course, but otherwise, the demo is yours to explore... on the telly!Read the full article on nintendolife.com
